configuration: VITE_GA4_MEASUREMENT_ID at build time, or ga4MeasurementId in src/data/analyticsConfig.ts

stream_settings_required.enhanced_measurement: OFF: manual page views and contact events are provided; automatic outbound-link collection could include WhatsApp draft text

consent: Google tag loads only after analytics consent. Footer settings allow withdrawal.

events.page_view: Once per pathname transition after document metadata update; query/hash excluded except allow-listed campaign parameters
events.whatsapp_click: Contact-link click; no WhatsApp URL/message body is sent by custom tracking
events.enquiry_preview: Valid enquiry draft preview; optional allow-listed service_id only
events.training_interest_preview: Training-interest draft preview; no name/organisation/location fields

limits: Clicks/previews are not confirmed messages, calls or sales. Google account ownership, stream configuration and delivery verification require the owner and a real Measurement ID.
